name: submit_fmla_case
description: submit_fmla_case: Open an FMLA leave case. Returns a case_id on success. Rejects the request if the employee is not eligible or if the requested leave duration exceeds the remaining FMLA balance.

employee_id.description: The employee's ID. Format: EMP followed by 6 digits. Example: EMP048271

leave_category.description: The FMLA leave category (mutually exclusive): employee_medical_condition (employee's own serious health condition), family_member_serious_illness (caring for ill spouse, child, or parent), bonding (birth, adoption, or foster placement within 12 months), or military_exigency (family member's active duty)

leave_start_date.description: The first day of leave in YYYY-MM-DD format. Must be today or a future date. Example: 2026-05-01

leave_end_date.description: The last day of leave in YYYY-MM-DD format. The total duration must not exceed the employee's remaining FMLA weeks. Example: 2026-07-01
